title: Piyush Profile
content: Name: Piyush, 22, MCA graduate, backend developer working in Node.js, based in Pune (lives in a PG), originally from Bramhapuri. First-generation person in tech. Builder-oriented across game dev, 3D modeling and backend systems, with founder instincts. Motivated by making things exist rather than mastering tools for their own sake. Strong conceptual thinker with verbal and reasoning fluency; tends to rush explanations by skipping steps.
